text: Provide Reserve for Doubtful Debts @ 3% on Sundry Debtors. 3. On 1st January 2023, M/s Jupiter Logistics purchased industrial machinery from M/s Titan Engineering Works on hire purchase terms. The total cash price of the machinery was ₹9,00,000. A down payment of ₹1,00,000 was made immediately upon signing the contract. The balance was payable in four semi-annual instalments of ₹2,00,000 each, plus interest at 8% per annum on the outstanding balance. Jupiter Logistics paid the first and second instalments on their due dates but failed to pay the third instalment due on 30th June 2024. Consequently, on the same day , after negotiation, it was agreed that the purchaser would retain a portion of the machinery (original cash price ₹4,50,000), while the remaining portion was repossessed by the seller at an agreed value of ₹3,40,000. A new agreement was signed for the payment of the balance amount. Jupiter Logistics charges depreciation at 10% p.a. on the Written Down Value (WDV) basis. In the books of Jupiter Logistics prepare : The statement of interest calculations for all 2 years up to 31/12/2024 Machinery Account and Depreciation Account for the years ending 31/12/2023 and 31/12/2024 M/s Titan Engineering Works Account up to the date of re-possession. subject: Fundamentals of Financial Accounting II
text: Mr. Somnath purchased machinery from M/s Badrinath Ltd. on hire purchase on 01/01/2023 The cash price of the machinery was ₹4,00,000. The terms of payment were: ₹40,000 payable immediately and the balance payable in three annual instalments of ₹1,20,000 each plus interest at 12% per annum on the outstanding balance on 31st December every year. Mr. Somnath paid the down payment and the first two instalments in time. However, he informed his inability to pay on 30/06/2025, whereupon M/s Badrinath Ltd. repossessed the machinery on 30/06/2025 for the amount due up to the date of repossession, after charging proportionate interest up to that date. Mr. Somnath depreciates machinery at 30% per annum on WDV basis and closes his books on 31st December every year. You are required to show statement of interest calculation for all three years up to 31/12/2025 and also prepare Machinery A/c and M/s Badrinath Ltd. A/c in the books of Mr. Somnath for the years ending 31/12/2023, 31/12/2024 and 31/12/2025
